The user wants to restore the exact state of the editor when reopening a project: cursor position, open files, and visible/closed side panels.
The previous plan tried to find "save editor state" and "restore editor state" in `editor state cpp/hpp`.
T3 closed saying: "no encontré el mecanismo de guardar restaurar estado del editor; lo leído son funciones de gestión de cursores reset to single cursor, set primary y la estructura Editor Buffer, sin serialización ni persistencia".
It also mentions `restore workspace session` and `open file` in T2, but T3 says no
